integrity: The statement has a complete ordinary mathematical proof and reproducible bounded computational checks. The record does not assert independent validation or historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The first-power rank is known. The new assertion is the second-power rank and full nilpotent Jordan/extinction filtration for all \(d\ge2\). Historical uniqueness is not certified; full text of the direct 2010 coding paper was inaccessible, while related Chapter 5 of the 2013 thesis was inspected. Numerical checks only cover dimensions two through eight.
title: Three-step nilpotence and constant two-block multiplicity in cubical edge-parity dynamics
